subject: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan — BrightLane POC
messages:
From: Alex Forbes <aforbes@brightlane.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: eng-team@brightlane.ai
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan — BrightLane POC

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The execs liked the latency and cost profile you showed for the retrieval-augmented generation flows. We're ready to put together a short mutual action plan so we can get an evaluation running and confirm an FY close target.

Key asks from our side:
- A short MAP that lists owners and a 3-week pilot timeline (discovery, run, analyze)
- Names of the technical owners (SE/ML) we'll be working with for prompts, dataset sync, and runbooks
- Any initial security/compliance artifacts (SOC2 summary, data handling notes) we should hand to procurement

Would love to schedule a 30-minute kickoff next week. Our preferred windows are Tue/Wed 10–12 PT.

Thanks,
Alex Forbes
Head of Data & ML
BrightLane

From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Forbes <aforbes@brightlane.ai>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan — BrightLane POC

Hi Alex — great to hear this is moving forward.

I've looped in our Solutions Engineer (Jonas Weber) and ML Engineer (Soojin Lee) who will lead the technical side. Quick intro:
- Jonas Weber (SE) — will own the runtime configuration, batching, and demo reproducibility.
- Soojin Lee (ML Eng) — will own prompt evaluation, dataset ingestion guidance, and quality gates.

Proposed MAP (high level):
Week 0 (this week): Align stakeholders, share MAP doc and security artifacts.
Week 1: Discovery + baseline runs (small dataset) — SE + BrightLane eng pair to validate integration.
Week 2: Full evaluation runs, cost/latency profiling, prompt sweeps.
Week 3: Analysis, final recommendations, and close readiness review.

Owners and initial asks:
- BrightLane: Alex (exec sponsor), BrightLane Eng (technical lead) — provide a sample dataset + access details.
- Redwood: Lauren (AM) — MAP facilitation; Jonas (SE) — infra/run ownership; Soojin (ML Eng) — quality & eval metrics.

I created a living MAP doc and started a timeline (link below). Can you confirm who from BrightLane's eng team should join the kickoff and which of Tue/Wed 10–12 PT works?

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_MAP_kickoff_brightlane

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Forbes <aforbes@brightlane.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: eng-team@brightlane.ai, procurement@brightlane.ai
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan — BrightLane POC

Thanks Lauren — Tue 10:30 PT works for us. I've looped in our eng lead (Samir Patel) and procurement so they can join.

Samir will take point on the dataset handoff (S3 link) and runbook questions. I'm also attaching the BrightLane security questionnaire—procurement wants that completed before we run any data into a vendor environment.

Attachment: BrightLane_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (security questionnaire, 11 pages)

See you Tue 10:30 PT.

Best,
Alex

From: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Alex Forbes <aforbes@brightlane.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & evaluation plan — BrightLane POC

Quick internal note before the kickoff:
- Jonas: please prepare a checklist for dataset ingestion (S3 presigned policy, prefix rules, sample size for baseline).
- Soojin: bring the eval template and a short list of quality gates we'll run in Week 2.
- I'll map the timeline in the MAP doc and confirm calendar invite for Tue 10:30 PT.

If either of you foresee any blockers (e.g., need for private deployment option or additional compliance docs), flag them early so we can surface to Alex before the meeting.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth handoff.
Lauren
